text.title: FreshDrop reminder feature, PRD v1.2, 1 September 2026
text.background: 1 in 3 buyers misses an evening slot (survey, 420 answers); support gets 60 calls a week
text.goals: Cut missed slots by 30% by Q4 2026; not in scope: SMS and web reminders
text.segment: Moscow families who order weekly; they plan the week on Sunday
text.market: About 180,000 weekly buyers in Moscow; a push costs 0.3 RUB
text.proposal: A push 15 minutes before the slot with a one-tap change
text.risks: Buyers turn push off: test with 50 buyers; opt-out must stay below 10%
text.solution: Push at slot minus 15 minutes; change or cancel in one tap; mockups in Figma v3
text.plan: 3 sprints, 2 mobile engineers, 1 tester; launch after the QA gate on 20 September
text.launch: 500 weekly buyers in Khimki first; in-app banner and push; support briefed
text.postlaunch: Success: missed slots below 6%. Failure: opt-out above 20% means rollback
text.decision: Engineers can build it and the tester can check each requirement; hand off to development on 1 October
